floor_layers._pick: #225 first floor layer (was biome-default inn plank, zero floor_layers): the Brothers' parlor reads as a richer parquet than the plain inn plank -- a classy gentleman-thieves' establishment. Library pack warm reddish parquet ([21,3]/[22,3]/[21,4]/[23,4], rgb~135,86,50), already manifest-wired (bundle:true). Chosen over castle brown [6,18], which windowed-read too close to the inn plank to differentiate. Rugs (rug_tan/rug_green) still dress it on top; footstep-wood stays honest. (Shares the guild's parquet: both are finer establishments in different cities -- an acceptable, thematic overlap.)

entities._comment: talk_pool stays the pool-then-conversation precedent's first-talk-of-a-waking flavor (interact()'s npc branch), `conversation` carries every later talk into the real graph.
entities.observe: A Gnoll in a vest cut sharper than his manners need to be, tall hat squared like it's holding a rank. He watches the room's exits before he watches you.
entities.friendly_line: He inclines the hat half an inch — a genuine courtesy, not a performance of one. "A pleasure," he says, and seems to mean it.
talk_pool: Evening. Might I say, {addr}, you carry yourself like a person things happen to. We collect a few of those.
Manners cost nothing and buy everything, in my experience. Mind the rug — Normen fusses over it more than he'll admit.
You'll notice the hat stays on. Best we keep it that way, between friends.
We don't steal, whatever you've heard. We RECOVER. It's a finer distinction than it sounds, and it's the whole of our business.

dialogue.speaker: Wilovan
dialogue.text: Evening, {addr}. Fine weather for good behavior.

entities.sleep_toast: Even a couch here fits like it was fitted for you. The Brothers do nothing halfway, not even hospitality.

entities._comment: Bespoke short-Drake rig replaces the flagged pc_drake_m+tint placeholder. Voice/profile contract: docs/design/character-profiles.md Ratici section (fast, dropped g's, fancy-word overreach, menace opens polite; [Gentleman Thief] 7.24 is the class-name ceiling, [Aerial Dodge] is Vol-8 and BANNED).
entities.observe: A short Drake in careful browns, floppy cap settled down over the neck-spines. His eyes did your full inventory the moment you stepped in, and he's too polite to say what it came to.
entities.friendly_line: A person of discernment, Wilovan said. I withdraw one full half of my suspicions.
talk_pool: Somethin' I can do for you? Ask quick — I talk faster'n I listen, as it were.
You'll pardon the hat stayin' on. Consider it a heretofore act of civic kindness.
Wilovan does the philosophizin'. I do the notin' of exits. You came in by the only one, incidentally.
We don't steal. We RECOVER. My associate's phrasin', that. Mine ran less charitable.

lines: Boulevard's where the operation runs, friend. Start where the money's loudest.

talk_pool_stages._comment: Marker-holders get the warmer register (fence-tier trust, same gate as Wilovan's fence).
lines: Marker-holder. Sit where you like, then — the good stool's the one that doesn't wobble.
Word went round about the Coyle business. Tidy work. Rougher'n I'd have done it, or gentler. One of the two.

entities.observe: A broad man in a bowler hat, playing solitaire like the deck owes him money. Politely, though.
talk_pool: Evenin'. The cards are friendly here. The stakes, somewhat less so.
House rule: hats stay on. You'll know the exception when you see it, and you'll want to be elsewhere for it.

entities.observe: A Gnoll with a folded coat over one arm, keeping polite company with the hat stand and the door.
talk_pool: The cots? For gentlemen between engagements. Which is all of us, officially.
Mind the rug. A fellow scuffed it once. The apology took longer than the mending.

entities.observe: A Drake on a stool with his back to the wall, minding the shelf and the chest the way other men mind a fire.
talk_pool: The shelf's spoken for, friend. Marker-holders and upward.

entities.observe: A drink counter kept cleaner than the law would ever ask it to be.
Rings from a hundred glasses, sanded out and earned back.
Bottles arranged by loyalty rather than label. The top row is for after jobs that went well.
A keg with a tapped face and an honest week's dents.
Its brother. Slightly fuller, slightly further from the door.

entities._comment: Card table cluster: table_brown reuse (the existing (6,5) table is Wilovan's SITTING table; this one is the game). Stools flank.
entities.observe: Coppers, a dog-eared deck, and chalk tallies in three different handwritings. The game never quite ends; it just changes players.
The wobbly one. Guests get it first.
The good stool. You'd have to earn it.

entities._comment: Fence-adjacent stash dressing: interact is gated DIEGETICALLY (locked line) on brothers_marker, mirroring Wilovan's fence gate — no mechanics beyond flavor + the existing fence node carrying actual stock.
entities.observe: Banded oak, twice-locked, sitting where the quiet gentleman can count who looks at it.
entities.toast: Locked twice over. The quiet gentleman clears his throat, courteously.

entities.observe: Ledgers with no titles and boxes with no labels. Everything here is filed under later.
Army-neat. Whoever sleeps here folds corners like it still matters.
Less neat. A paperback under the pillow, spine broken at the same chapter.

entities._comment: Bespoke hat-stand sprite replaces the flagged crate placeholder; preserves the Brothers' hats-off tell.
entities.observe: Hats on pegs, every one accounted for. House rule says they stay on. Nobody explains the exceptions, and nobody asks twice.
